column1: 20144§juggle§ˈdʒʌɡl§Many university students have to juggle part-time jobs with their studies and family responsibilities.§许多大学生不得不**同时应付**兼职工作、学业和家庭责任。§补例句
20145§leak§liːk§If there were a gas leak in this room, the average person would notice fairly quickly.§如果这个房间发生煤气**泄漏**，一般人很快就会察觉到。§
20146§literature§ˈlɪtrətʃə(r)§Jane taught English literature at my old high school.§简在我的中学母校教英国**文学**。§
20147§suffer§ˈsʌfə(r)§They all suffer from chronic back pain.§他们都**患有**慢性背部疼痛。§
20148§impede§ɪmˈpiːd§The lack of a common language can severely impede progress.§缺少一种通用语言会严重**阻碍**进程。§
20149§spring§sprɪŋ§He was born in the spring of 1995.§他出生于1995年**春天**。§
20150§biological§ˌbaɪəˈlɒdʒɪkl§Scientists are doing research to find the biological effects of radiation.§科学家正在进行研究，想发现辐射的**生物**效应。§
20151§deduce§dɪˈdjuːs§They cannot deduce very much from these simple figures.§他们无法从这些简单的数据中**推断**出很多东西。§

20158§surroundings§səˈraʊndɪŋz§Those who could afford to live in more pleasant surroundings moved out.§那些支付得起更舒适的**环境**的人都搬了出去。§

20163§notion§ˈnəʊʃn§The emergence of a new style of architecture reflects more idealistic notions for the future.§一种新建筑风格的出现反映了关于未来的更理想主义的**观念**。§

20166§fold§fəʊld§He decided to fold up Phoebe's massage table.§他决定把菲比的按摩桌**折叠**起来。§
20167§instrument§ˈɪnstrəmənt§We use questionnaires as our main research instrument.§我们将问卷调查作为主要的研究**手段**。§
20168§simplify§ˈsɪmplɪfaɪ§These self-help books are designed for people who want to simplify their lives.§这些自助书籍是为那些想**简化**生活的人设计的。§
20169§irritation§ˌɪrɪˈteɪʃn§Tom couldn't hide his irritation that he failed the exam.§汤姆无法掩饰自己因考试不及格而产生的**恼怒**情绪。§

20171§expense§ɪkˈspens§I am sure you will be concerned about expenses such as books and uniforms when your child starts studying.§我敢肯定，当你的孩子开始上学时，你会关心书本、制服等**花费**。§
20172§muddle§ˈmʌdl§I'm in such a muddle that I completely forgot to do my homework.§我真**糊涂**，竟把家庭作业完全抛到了脑后。§改例句：忘记作业是已发生的事，forget 应为过去式 forgot
20173§originate§əˈrɪdʒɪneɪt§According to my research, this type of banana actually originated in China.§根据我的研究，事实上，这种香蕉**起源**于中国。§
20174§induce§ɪnˈdjuːs§Nothing would induce me to change my idea.§任何事都不能**使**我改变主意。§

20177§disharmony§ˌdɪsˈhɑːməni§The disharmony of a person-environment mismatch is likely to result in low job satisfaction.§人与工作环境的**不和谐**很可能会导致工作满意度低。§
20178§cosset§ˈkɒsɪt§Tom is one who cossets his health.§汤姆是个**悉心保养**身体的人。§
20179§unique§juˈniːk§Biometric security systems operate by storing a digitised record of some unique human features.§生物测定安全系统通过储存某些**独特**的人类特征的数字化记录来运行。§
20180§disagree§ˌdɪsəˈgriː§They disagreed about love.§他们对爱情**持有不同的看法**。§

20182§inclusive§ɪnˈkluːsɪv§The fully inclusive fee for the trip to that country will be higher in summer vacation.§暑假去那个国家旅行的**全部**费用会高一些。§
20183§reservation§ˌrezəˈveɪʃn§I was advised to make a reservation in advance for the seats.§别人建议我提前**预订**座位。§
20184§transcript§ˈtrænskrɪpt§The professor was reading the transcript of the interview.§教授正在看面试的**文字记录**。§

20186§reasonable§ˈriːznəbl§I think you'll find the methods very reasonable.§我认为你会觉得这些方法很**合理**。§
20187§abode§əˈbəʊd§I do not dare to linger in that gloom-hidden abode.§我不敢在那个隐没于黑暗中的**房屋**里逗留。§

20189§emergency§ɪˈmɜːdʒənsi§If it's an emergency, you can phone at any time.§如果发生**紧急情况**，你可以随时来电。§
20190§legacy§ˈlegəsi§Mary received this house as a legacy from her uncle.§玛丽从她叔叔那**继承**了这栋房子。§
20191§leisure§ˈleʒə(r)§Some people believe that children's leisure activities must be educational, otherwise they are a complete waste of time.§一些人认为，孩子们的**休闲**活动必须具有教育意义，否则纯粹是浪费时间。§
20192§overlap§ˌəʊvəˈlæp§Our jobs overlap slightly, which causes difficulties.§我们的工作略有**重叠**，所以有时引起一些困难。§

20195§strike§straɪk§The strike quickly spread to other states.§**罢工**很快波及了其他州。§

20197§represent§ˌreprɪˈzent§The discovery of the reaction principle represents one of the great milestones in the history of scientific thought.§在科学思想史上，反应原理的发现**是**一座伟大的丰碑。§
20198§vanish§ˈvænɪʃ§Topsoil in certain countries is vanishing faster and faster.§在某些国家，地表土**流失**的速度越来越快。§
